average.rule: per-draw MIDDLE crossing of the AVERAGE failure curve E_u[sigmoid(g+tau*u)] (Gauss-Hermite 21), the position interpolated in logit(rate) between the bracketing grid points (middle_crossings: the interior sign changes plus an edge crossing at the easy end where the curve is above the level at the easiest grid point and at the hard end where it is below it at the hardest; the middle of the odd list; an easy-edge middle left-censored, a hard-edge middle right-censored); quantiles over all draws with the censored ones beyond their ends, the conditional summaries beside; same lt_levels as levels_table; grid-quantization note applies equally

median_task.rule: per-draw MIDDLE crossing (middle_crossings; the position interpolated in logit(rate) between the bracketing grid points: the interior sign changes plus an edge crossing at the easy end where the curve is above the level at the easiest grid point and at the hard end where it is below it at the hardest; the middle of the odd list; an easy-edge middle left-censored, a hard-edge middle right-censored), quantiles over all draws with the censored ones beyond their ends — the same summarization as estimands.d50/d1; the canonical 0.50/0.01 levels are grid members exactly
